## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

S6.1a is Stage 6's first slice. GATE-G3 confirmed the seven §9.7
preconditions on landed evidence — the build already had `exp/`
namespaces, the `retirement` kind + ADR-0126 removal test,
`plugin_abi/1` `subprocess_confined`, and the deferred
`evolution_link` obligation. What did not exist: the pipeline itself.

## Decisions

See **ADR-0320** — records-in/records-out engine (D1), the closed
durable state machine (D2), `evolution_link` on the hypothesized
transition (D3), `RetirementBatch` in the removal-test gate set (D4),
stage-kind admission as a gate (D5), the C4 removable slice (D6), the
learned-policy evidence chain (D7), shadow-only canary + caller-side
invert-restore (D8), the human-review promotion gate (D9).

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **`check_stage_experiment` stage parameter was unenforced** — the
  shared spec check accepted any `kind` for any stage. Landed the §05h
  §4 stage tables as a gate: eval stages admit
  `comparative`/`equivalence`, S10 admits `is_retirement()`; the new
  `Refusal::StageKindMismatch{experiment_id, kind, stage}` stamps the
  refusing stage (`S4`/`S5`/`S10`).
- **S1 fixture invertibility** — the original fixture replaced a
  `Null` trigger with an object; the inverse then tried to restore a
  missing schema member (`$.nodes[2].semantic.trigger`). The fixture
  now carries a real trigger value so apply/invert round-trips
  byte-identically.
- **Idempotent reopen + writer lease** — the same split ref must carry
  the same body across opens (content-addressed dedup), and a second
  `open`/`ensure` shares or waits on the live writer lease
  (`WouldBlock` under a live holder; the tests advance the
  `ManualClock` where takeover is the leg under test).
- **Edit-tool write-loss anomaly** — the S5.6-documented anomaly
  recurred on `crates/hh-evolution/src/{errors,campaign}.rs` and the
  `s6_1a.rs` import block (edits reported applied, later absent on
  disk). Re-applied via shell/python and verified by `grep` — the
  "verify by reading the file after every divergent edit" rule holds.
